caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized flowers and leaves in a dark brown or black vase. The central flower is large, red, and tulip-like with three main petals, three inner upright petals, and decorative markings in a darker hue. Flanking this central flower on both sides are two similar, slightly smaller red flowers, each with five rounded petals and black centers, as well as thin curving black stems with black circular ends. Below and beside these flowers are two hanging, heart-shaped red flowers with light lines and pointed tips. Interspersed among the flowers are multiple elongated, curved leaves colored in yellow or gold, attached to black or dark brown stems that branch symmetrically from the vase. The background is an off-white or beige paper, and the composition is balanced and centralized on the page.
title: Drawing for Plate 5: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
